It takes real courage to put these feelings into words, and I'm glad you reached out. When you mention wondering if things would be better if you weren't around, that tells me you're carrying a very heavy weight right now. Please know your safety matters. If those thoughts feel strong or you have any urge to act on them, reach out right now to a crisis line—in the US you can call or text 988, and elsewhere emergency services can connect you to help. You don't have to hold this alone.

What you're feeling—like everyone else has it easier—is a common part of struggling, but it doesn't reflect the truth of your worth or your situation. Many people quietly face pain they don't show. Could you reach out to even one person you trust, or a doctor, to start talking about what's been happening? You deserve support, and things can shift even when they feel stuck right now.
